entities.name: King Narfi
entities.description: Zombie wizard and cruel king of Karfell on Kaldheim, made undead by a deal with Egon.

entities.name: Karfell
entities.description: Narfi's realm, with packed treasure vaults.

entities.name: Egon
entities.description: The strange visitor, future God of the Dead, who made Narfi and his army undead.

entities.name: Dread Marn
entities.description: Narfi's army of raiders that pillage other realms.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Made a deal with Narfi about access to treasures when the Doomskar started.

entities.name: Valki
entities.description: A god kept in Narfi's dungeon.

entities.name: Elves of Kaldheim
entities.description: Gave Narfi's father the magical longship and sought his armies against the gods.

entities.name: Draugr
entities.description: Undead into which Narfi's fallen soldiers rose.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: Event giving the Dread Marn chances to pillage.

events.summary: The elves take back their longship when Narfi refuses to lend his armies to their war against the gods.
events.quote: the elves took back their longship until he agreed to help

events.summary: Egon offers to lead Narfi's army in exchange for protection from death; Narfi agrees, and his fallen soldiers rise as draugr, Narfi himself becoming undead.
events.quote: The visitor revealed himself to be Egon

events.summary: Narfi makes a deal with Tibalt, keeping Valki in his dungeon in exchange for access to treasures.
events.quote: Narfi made a deal with Tibalt

relations.quote: King Narfi maintains an army of raiders known as the Dread Marn
Narfi was the king of Karfell
